class.name: WindZone3D
class.brief_description: Local wind in a sphere or a box, on top of the world's wind or replacing it.
class.description: Adds wind inside its shape to the [WindServer]'s wind, so foliage using the wind shader include, [WindReceiver3D] bodies, cloth and [method WindServer.sample] all feel it. [b]Directional[/b] blows along the node's -Z axis, like a fan, a wind tunnel or a downdraft (point it down). [b]Radial[/b] blows outward from the center (inward with a negative strength): a rotor's downwash along the ground, or a blast when you animate [member strength]. [b]Vortex[/b] turns around the node's +Y axis: a dust devil or a whirl. With [member replace_global], the zone replaces the world's wind instead of adding to it; with a [member strength] of [code]0[/code] that makes a sheltered spot, such as a courtyard or the inside of a building. The wind is full strength inside and fades to nothing over [member falloff] toward the edge. The node's scale stretches the shape. Up to 64 zones can be active at once; zones are applied in the order they entered the tree. Foliage bends with the horizontal part of the wind, so use a radial zone for downwash on grass. [codeblock] var blast := WindZone3D.new() blast.mode = WindZone3D.MODE_RADIAL blast.radius = 15.0 add_child(blast) blast.global_position = explosion_position var tween := create_tween() tween.tween_property(blast, "strength", 0.0, 0.6).from(40.0) tween.tween_callback(blast.queue_free) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_wind_at
method.description: The wind this zone adds at a world [param position] (its own wind times the falloff weight), without the world's wind.

method.name: is_inside
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the world [param position] is inside the zone's shape.

members.member: When off, the zone has no effect.
The share of the shape, from the edge in, over which the wind fades out. [code]0.0[/code] is a hard edge.
How the air moves in the zone.
The radius of the sphere, in meters.
If [code]true[/code], the zone replaces the world's wind inside its shape (blending at the falloff) instead of adding to it.
The size of the box, in meters.
The zone's wind speed, in meters per second. Negative reverses it.

constants.constant: Blows outward from the center (inward for a negative strength).
Turns around the node's +Y axis (counterclockwise seen from above for a positive strength).
